- .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:631-1049 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The live hook is the pre-review-round version of the module (2008 lines vs the template's 2076). It has no `full_*` keys in `_run_one()` (734–759), no class-qualified cap check in `_failing_names_readable()` (837–862), no `method (module.Class)` comparison in `classify_baseline()` (1024–1049), and still uses `reason.startswith("helper:test_")` at line 631.
  WHY: The interactive `PreToolUse` hook runs this stale code, so it classifies the same change differently from the template the pipeline gates load and brings back the miss class issue #10249 was filed for; the source severity was MAJOR, mapped here to high.

  EVIDENCE: The PR diff leaves the two copies at different blobs (live 6f7f5b28b138 vs template f6d8380028c7). The live file lacks `_UNITTEST_QUALIFIED_RE`, `_output_failing_set()`, `_unittest_qualified_names()` and `_unit_unittest_names()` (template lines 163, 855-880). It lacks the `full_names`/`full_unittest_names`/`full_first_failure` keys in `_run_one()` (template lines 750, 759, 770, 782-784; live lines 734–759). It lacks the qualified-cap check in `_failing_names_readable()` (template lines 882-883). It lacks the qualified-unittest comparison and `full_first_failure` use in `classify_baseline()` (template lines 1102-1109; live lines 1024–1049). Its `_is_indirect_entry()` is not based on `is_test_file()` (live line 631 still uses `reason.startswith("helper:test_")`; live 628–631 vs template 632-647). The last run's three return-path additions widened the drift. `tests/claude_template_drift.py::pending_template_paths` (lines 100-104) does not tolerate drift when both copies changed, so `tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py` (lines 41–53) fails. The PR acceptance table marks the parity test `unmet`. Prior editor summaries (comments 7236836267 and 7237119136, among others) logged the sync as BLOCKED because the editor sandbox excludes the live file. The interactive hook runs the live copy, while scripts/implement_step_prepush_test_gate.sh lines 275-277 load the template as a fallback and `scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:340-346` picks the live copy first. The fix is to copy template blob f6d8380028c7 over .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py, outside the sandbox.
- requirement: Issue #10249 items 1, 3, 4: name-level baseline comparison, test-module-as-helper rule 3, and indirect-units-planned-last ordering — the gate must execute the fix, not just document it.
  expected_change_site: The four touched scripts/Dockerfiles plus the live hook (`.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py`) that the gate actually executes when the live copy differs from the template.
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: In the live copy, `_run_one()` does not capture `full_*` keys, so name-level comparison falls back to the tail on long tracebacks. `_is_indirect_entry()` matches only `helper:test_*`, so `*_test.py` and `__tests__/` importers are not planned last. `classify_baseline()` has no qualified-unittest comparison, so a method failing in a new class is reported as inherited. The agents.d fragment at line 6 describes the template's behaviour, not what runs.
